snippet.title: Few Shall Return: Open Playtest July 18 - 20
snippet.description:
Join the playtest and don't forget to wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3377400/Few_Shall_Return/

You’ve entered a dungeon with other adventurers, but only a few of you will be allowed to leave. Work together to solve challenges, but escape alone. Risk losing what you bring in with you, but keep all the loot that you can carry… if you make it out alive. Short rounds (10-15min). Full multiplayer RPG experience.

After July 20, you can still sign up for future playtests!
